description: This file contains definitions for benchmarking throughput of PyTorch modules, including classes for execution statistics and a wrapper for a C++ throughput benchmark component.

classes.name: ExecutionStats
classes.description: Class for calculating and representing execution statistics of a benchmark run.

classes.name: ThroughputBenchmark
classes.description: Wrapper class around a C++ throughput benchmark component for measuring PyTorch module throughput.

methods.name: format_time
methods.description: Formats a time duration given in microseconds, milliseconds, or seconds into a string.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for ExecutionStats and ThroughputBenchmark classes.

methods.name: run_once
methods.description: Runs the benchmark once with given inputs and returns prediction.

methods.name: add_input
methods.description: Stores a single input into the benchmark's memory for later use.

methods.name: benchmark
methods.description: Runs the benchmark on the module with specified parameters and returns execution statistics.
